mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, group_link_id, status, trigger_source, attempt_count, next_run_at, lease_until, execution_account_id, rerun_requested, current_command_id, requested_scope_mask, completed_scope_mask, candidate_cursor, result_deadline_at, last_started_at, last_success_at, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at

ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE trigger_source = VALUES(trigger_source), attempt_count = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN attempt_count ELSE 0 END, next_run_at = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN next_run_at ELSE VALUES(next_run_at) END, lease_until = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN lease_until ELSE NULL END, execution_account_id = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN execution_account_id ELSE NULL END, current_command_id = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN current_command_id ELSE NULL END, requested_scope_mask = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN requested_scope_mask ELSE 0 END, completed_scope_mask = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN completed_scope_mask ELSE VALUES(completed_scope_mask) END, candidate_cursor = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN candidate_cursor ELSE 0 END, result_deadline_at = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN result_deadline_at ELSE NULL END, rerun_requested = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END, last_error_code = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN last_error_code ELSE NULL END, last_error_message = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN last_error_message ELSE NULL END, status = CASE WHEN status = #{runningStatus} THEN status ELSE VALUES(status) END, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM group_metadata_sync_task WHERE group_link_id = #{groupLinkId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE group_metadata_sync_task SET status = #{row.status}, next_run_at = #{row.nextRunAt}, lease_until = NULL, execution_account_id = NULL, candidate_cursor = CASE WHEN current_command_id IS NULL THEN candidate_cursor ELSE candidate_cursor + 1 END, current_command_id = NULL, requested_scope_mask = 0, result_deadline_at = NULL, rerun_requested = FALSE, last_error_code = #{row.lastErrorCode}, last_error_message = #{row.lastErrorMessage}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE status = #{runningStatus} AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{row.updatedAt}

UPDATE group_metadata_sync_task SET status = #{row.status}, next_run_at = #{row.nextRunAt}, lease_until = NULL, execution_account_id = NULL, candidate_cursor = CASE WHEN current_command_id IS NULL THEN candidate_cursor ELSE candidate_cursor + 1 END, current_command_id = NULL, requested_scope_mask = 0, result_deadline_at = NULL, rerun_requested = FALSE, last_error_code = #{row.lastErrorCode}, last_error_message = #{row.lastErrorMessage}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE status = #{runningStatus} AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{row.updatedAt}

UPDATE group_metadata_sync_task SET completed_scope_mask = CASE WHEN MOD(FLOOR(completed_scope_mask / #{scopeMask}), 2) = 1 THEN completed_scope_mask ELSE completed_scope_mask + #{scopeMask} END, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, #{observedAt}) WHERE current_command_id = #{commandId}
mapper.select: SELECT task.id, task.tenant_id, task.group_link_id, task.status, task.trigger_source, task.attempt_count, task.next_run_at, task.lease_until, task.execution_account_id, task.rerun_requested, task.current_command_id, task.requested_scope_mask, task.completed_scope_mask, task.candidate_cursor, task.result_deadline_at, task.last_started_at, task.last_success_at, task.last_error_code, task.last_error_message, task.created_at, task.updated_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.group_jid), ''), CASE WHEN link.link_url LIKE 'wa://group/%' THEN SUBSTRING(link.link_url, CHAR_LENGTH('wa://group/') + 1) ELSE NULL END) AS groupJid FROM group_metadata_sync_task task INNER JOIN group_link link ON link.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND link.id = task.group_link_id AND link.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND current_group.id = link.group_id WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.current_command_id = #{commandId} LIMIT 1

SELECT task.id, task.tenant_id, task.group_link_id, task.status, task.trigger_source, task.attempt_count, task.next_run_at, task.lease_until, task.execution_account_id, task.rerun_requested, task.current_command_id, task.requested_scope_mask, task.completed_scope_mask, task.candidate_cursor, task.result_deadline_at, task.last_started_at, task.last_success_at, task.last_error_code, task.last_error_message, task.created_at, task.updated_at FROM group_metadata_sync_task task WHERE task.current_command_id = #{commandId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE group_metadata_sync_task SET status = #{row.status}, next_run_at = #{row.nextRunAt}, lease_until = NULL, execution_account_id = NULL, current_command_id = NULL, requested_scope_mask = 0, completed_scope_mask = #{row.completedScopeMask}, candidate_cursor = #{row.candidateCursor}, result_deadline_at = NULL, attempt_count = #{row.attemptCount}, rerun_requested = FALSE, last_success_at = COALESCE(#{row.lastSuccessAt}, last_success_at), last_error_code = #{row.lastErrorCode}, last_error_message = #{row.lastErrorMessage}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id} AND tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND status = #{runningStatus} AND current_command_id = #{row.currentCommandId}
mapper.select: SELECT task.id FROM group_metadata_sync_task task WHERE task.status = #{deferredStatus} AND task.completed_scope_mask = #{metadataCompleteMask} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_link link INNER JOIN wa_account_group_binding binding ON binding.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND binding.group_id = link.group_id AND binding.account_id = #{accountId} INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id AND self_participant.presence_status = 1 WHERE link.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND link.id = task.group_link_id AND link.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY task.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE group_metadata_sync_task task SET task.status = #{pendingStatus}, task.trigger_source = #{triggerSource}, task.next_run_at = #{now}, task.rerun_requested = FALSE, task.last_error_code = NULL, task.last_error_message = NULL, task.updated_at = #{now} WHERE task.status = #{deferredStatus} AND task.id IN #{id}
